title: 第13章 收仆求追读第14章 冰镇瓜求追读
content_zh:
;;
许家院落。
经过一夜的休息和充足食物，那对流民父子精气神好了许多。
他们老实站在院中，大手紧紧攥着小手，低着脑袋。
等待许川的决定。
“先说说你们的名字和来历吧。”许川淡淡道。
流民男子抬首道：“小的李乾风，二十有八，这是小儿，李泰阿，今年四岁，从西山县逃难而来。”
“乾风，泰阿，名字很有气度啊，你李家不是普通人家吧？”
“我观你脸色晦暗，但双目却是有神，一看就是练过武的。”
李乾风身躯一震，心中惊讶不已，他没想到一个小小的乡村，居然有如此见识的人。
“我......”李乾风犹豫了一会儿。
“我许家可不收满嘴谎言的人。”
李乾风心中悲苦。
他曾经也是西山县众人口中风度翩翩的李家二爷，如今家族覆灭，也不知道有几个族人活下来。
往事如烟，都归于尘土。
李乾风看了看自己的小儿子，眼中满是怜惜。
他如今也只求有个栖身之所，让他儿子能免去流离之苦。
于是，李乾风开始缓缓道出自家的身世。
闻言，许川来回踱步，装作沉思。
片刻后。

他对着李氏父子道：“收下你们可，但我只收家仆。”
“相对的，鉴于你们李家有仇敌，你们若是留下，必须改名。”
“我会提供衣食住行，也可提供你儿学习练武。”
“如果答应，我便留下你们父子。”
听到这条件，李乾风也开始深思起来。
这许家规模远不如他们李家。
甚至还不如十分之一的强盛，但许川此人给他深不可测的感觉。
其志向远大，似乎要把许家打造成强盛的望族世家。
这世道，好心人不多。
他之前也乞求过几家，但能给一口水喝的都是好的了。
多数普通黎庶根本没有多余的能力留人，只能去清江县。
只是这又不知要过多少风餐露宿的日子。
连他都扛不住，更别说他儿子。
之前便差不多到极限了。
如今不过回过一口气，估计已经承受不起颠簸流离。
李乾风看得出许家从上到下都是良善之辈。
诸多考虑之后，他拉着李泰阿跪下道：“我愿与我儿，于许家为仆，心甘情愿，无怨无悔。”
许川微微一笑，“既如此，那我为你们父子重新取名吧。”
“请家主赐名。”
content_en:
;;
Xu family courtyard.
After a night's rest and plenty of food, the refugee father and son were in much better spirits.
They stood honestly in the courtyard, their big hands clasping their little hands tightly, their heads lowered.
Waiting for Xu Chuan's decision.
"First tell me your names and origins." Xu Chuan said calmly.
The refugee man raised his head and said: "Little Li Qianfeng, eight out of twenty, this is the child, Li Tai'a, four years old this year, who fled from Xishan County."
"Qianfeng, Tai'a, your name is very impressive. Your Li family is not an ordinary family, right?"
"I see that your face is gloomy, but your eyes are bright. You can tell that you have practiced martial arts."
Li Qianfeng's body trembled, and he was surprised. He didn't expect that there was such a knowledgeable person in a small village.
"I..." Li Qianfeng hesitated for a while.
"My Xu family does not accept people who tell lies."
Li Qianfeng felt sad in his heart.
He was once the elegant and elegant second master of the Li family in Xishan County. Now that the family has been destroyed, it is not known how many members of the clan have survived.
The past is like smoke, all returning to dust.
Li Qianfeng looked at his youngest son, his eyes full of pity.
Now he just wants a place to stay so that his son can avoid the pain of being homeless.
As a result, Li Qianfeng began to slowly reveal his life experience.
Hearing this, Xu Chuan paced back and forth, pretending to be deep in thought.
After a while.
He said to Li and his son: "I can accept you, but I only accept domestic servants."
"On the contrary, since you have enemies in the Li family, if you stay, you must change your name."
"I will provide food, clothing, housing and transportation, and I can also provide your son with training in martial arts."
"If you agree, I will keep you and your son."
After hearing this condition, Li Qianfeng also began to think deeply.
The Xu family is far smaller than their Li family.
It's not even as powerful as one-tenth, but Xu Chuan gave him an unfathomable feeling.
His ambition is lofty, and he seems to want to build the Xu family into a powerful and famous family.
There are not many good-hearted people in this world.
He had begged several people before, but those who could give him a sip of water were all good ones.
Most ordinary Li Shu people simply did not have the extra ability to retain people, so they had no choice but to go to Qingjiang County.
It’s just that I don’t know how many days I will live in the open air.
Even he couldn't bear it, let alone his son.
It was almost at its limit before.
Now that I have just taken a breath, I guess I can no longer bear the ups and downs.
Li Qianfeng could see that the Xu family was a kind person from top to bottom.
After much consideration, he pulled Li Tai'a and knelt down and said, "I would like to be a servant of the Xu family with my son. I am willing to do so without any regrets."
Xu Chuan smiled slightly and said, "In that case, let me rename you father and son."
"Please give me a name from the head of the family."
